x: Are we doomed to hover on the fringe eternally or can runners like Major, Bicourt, Piotrowski, Williams etc give us a lift up into the medals next year?.

Mann, O'COnnor and Piotrowski are all going better than ever while Bicourt has been showing excellent early form. Bill Dance is keeping in fine trim up in Huddersfield, and Major and O'Hara are also running into form again.

Kerr and Mann were pushing the early pace with O'Hara, Piotrowski, Fairclough and Major tagging along. The last two named lost contact at about 3,000 metres but the situation ahead of them took a dramatic turn at 5,000 metres when Piotrowski retired with a blistered foot.

Just 2 months away from becoming a 40 yrs old veteran, Laurie O'Hara was faced with a situation where he had little to gain (Piotrowski and Badgery were well ahead) and everything to lose (T.V.H., Aldershot, Portsmouth and Cambridge were all within striking distance).
